item.title: India Jewelers Hold Off Gold Buying, Betting Prices Will Drop
item.description: Indian jewelers are holding back gold purchases ahead of their busiest demand season, betting that a recent drop in prices has further to run, according to the country’s biggest precious metals refiner.

item.title: SK Hynix Posts Record Profit Amid AI Rush
item.description:
SK Hynix posted a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in quarterly profit and unveiled an additional shareholder return program for 2026 worth 100 trillion won ($75 billion), underscoring relentless demand for AI hardware. Counterpoint Research Director MS Hwang puts the results in the context of broader industry trends.
(Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: China Stock Premium Over Hong Kong Widens on State Intervention
item.description: Beijing’s efforts to stabilize its equity markets are helping drive the pricing gap between dual-listed stocks in China and Hong Kong to the widest level in nearly 17 months.

item.title: Fed Seen Holding Rates With Nod to December: Decision-Day Guide
item.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to hold interest rates steady on Wednesday even after inflation data for September came in hotter than expected.

item.title: Dallas Mavericks CEO on Team Investment and New Stadium
item.description: Dallas Mavericks CEO Rick Welts discusses the long-term capital required to build and sustain a professional sports enterprise with Bloomberg’s Randall Williams at Bloomberg Invest Dallas 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
